entries: **Claude Code side pane on Windows:** The system-tray panel menu now has the **Claude Code side pane** switch. The pane runs on Windows without POSIX tools (`tasklist` for live conversations, `findstr` for long transcripts), and `usage.exe status --json` supplies its quota data. Enabling it also turns on Claude Code's fullscreen layout, which the pane needs to dock on the right; turning the pane off switches the layout back.
**Claude Code side pane follows Hide Sections:** Tools hidden from the usage menu are also hidden in the pane and the compact box above the prompt, on macOS and Windows.
